---
name: Bug report
about: Something wrench does that it should not, in one pack
---

Which pack, and which codec.

The document, or the smallest one that still shows it. A file that reproduces
the behaviour is worth more than a description of one.

The call you made, and what came back. If it was an error, say which of the
seven kinds it was: `read`, `parse`, `validate`, `encode`, `write`, `schema` or
`usage`.

What you expected instead, and what makes you expect it. A line in
`docs/SPEC.md` or a requirement under `docs/REQUIREMENTS/` is the strongest form
of this, and is not required.

Do not report an exploitable defect here. `SECURITY.md` has the private route.
